result.final: Fixed wchunk to match the authoritative samples: little-endian u32 header count, fixed-width u16/u32 LE record framing (tag, size, payload), and standard zlib CRC-32 (little-endian footer) over header+records. Fixed codec (pack/unpack/verify), header, crc, and the lazy streaming reader (fixed-size read(n) only, checksum validated after last record, proper error kinds). pack(unpack(sample)) == sample holds for both samples and verify passes; public API and smoke tests unchanged.
